info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Favorites-v5-spec
info.description: The Favorite Pets Retrieval API allows users to access a curated list of pets that have been marked as favorites within the Pet Adoption system. This operation is pivotal for potential adopters who want to quickly view pets of interest. Users can leverage this endpoint to manage their selections and streamline their decision-making process. Ideal for pet adoption platforms, this API enhances user engagement by enabling easy access to preferred pets.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of pets marked as favorites by the user. It provides a simple way to access the user's preferred pets for quick reference.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the favorite pets for a user. It should contain the relevant details in JSON format to indicate which pets are marked as favorites.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of favorite pets.

ListPetadoptionPetsFavoritesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on pets' favorite items. It is expected to receive a string representing the favorite item.
